title: Ukraine and Russia Eye New Peace Talks as Zelensky Sets Conditions
detail: Reports say Ukraine and Russia are weighing new peace talks, with First Lady Melania Trump reportedly involved in a mission tied to the effort. Zelensky has set conditions for ending the war, and steep obstacles remain. Based on a single aggregated headline; details unverified. Al Jazeera adds that Ukraine-Russia-US negotiators are expected in Abu Dhabi in early November (Peskov confirmed) and a local Oleshky ceasefire is set to begin Oct 27 with a humanitarian operation Oct 29.

title: Ukrainian Drones Hit Petrochemical Plants in Togliatti and Omsk
detail: Al Jazeera reports a strike on the Togliattikauchuk petrochemical plant (Mayor Ilya Sukhikh confirmed industrial damage, no casualties) and a Fire Point claim of drone hits on a petrochemical plant and Ozon warehouse in Omsk. Kyiv also claimed a strike on the Proton electronics plant in Oryol (governor reported 3 deaths at an unidentified facility).

title: Ukraine Says Starlink Service Restored as Attacks Continue in Russia and Ukraine
detail: Ukraine says limits on its military's Starlink and Starshield connections have been lifted after more than a week of disruption that hampered drone operations. Defence Minister Yevhenii Khmara said links were stable on equipment moving above 400 km/h; Musk said SpaceX closed a 'loophole' over offensive drone use. Russian strikes killed 1 in Lozova (Kharkiv), at least 3 in Dnipropetrovsk region, and 1 in Kramatorsk with 6 wounded; Sloviansk saw 1 killed, 4 wounded.
